'''Amadaine''' is the seventh month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[June]] [[June 8|8]] to [[July]] [[July 6|6]]. [[Asadine]] occurs on the 3rd, [[Sunday]] occurs between the 13th and 14th during Amadaine, the [[Feast of Maia]] occurs on the 6th, and [[Bailene]] on the 9th.

In {{ne|998}}, [[The Great Hunt of the Horn]] was called in [[Illian]] on the [[Feast of Teven]] during Amadaine.
